title: Two kinds of saturation: why LLM-judge order bias is hard to measure
description: Essay, Lean 4 proofs (0 sorry / 0 axiom, gated by a build-time axiom audit), and a reproducible measurement of LLM-judge order effects across three judges. Includes an offline proof-of-concept that runs without an API key. One name, two mechanisms: saturation can manufacture an order effect, and separately it can destroy the observability needed to measure one.
